title: Fresh Spaghetti with Spicy Tomato and Seafood Sauce
preamble:
Cooking time about 45 minutes.
2 tbsp Olive oil
5 cloves garlic crushed
1 chilli finely chopped
1 onion finely chopped
¼ pint white wine
1x400g can chopped tomatoes
200ml fish or vegetable or chicken stock
1 x400g bag Seafood Cocktail, defrosted
2 teaspoons Italian Herbs
Fresh ground pepper
Fresh Egg Spaghetti or dried taglitelli

Cooking time about 45 minutes.

2 tbsp Olive oil

5 cloves garlic crushed

1 chilli finely chopped

1 onion finely chopped

¼ pint white wine

1x400g can chopped tomatoes

200ml fish or vegetable or chicken stock

1 x400g bag Seafood Cocktail, defrosted

2 teaspoons Italian Herbs

Fresh ground pepper

Fresh Egg Spaghetti or dried taglitelli

Method:-
1/ Heat oil and sauté garlic, chilli and onion for 5 mins until onion starting to soften
2/ Add the wine and reduce for 2 minutes
3/ Add tomatoes and stock and simmer for 20 minutes until sauce has reduced and thickened slightly
4/ Stir in Seafood Collection, the herbs and black pepper and cook for 5 minutes until the seafood is heated through
5/ Serve with spaghetti or taglitelli and top with parmesan and more black pepper
6/ Serve with ciabatta bread and green salad
